pages.seoTitle: Anish Karki: freelance web developer in Kathmandu
pages.seoDescription: Freelance web developer in Kathmandu. Websites and web apps for shops, schools and clinics, built to load fast on Nepali mobile data.

props.title: I build websites that load on a 4G bar in Dhading
props.text: Six years building sites and small web apps for shops, schools and clinics. I design a little, write the copy with you, and hand over something you can edit.

props.heading: What I can take off your plate

items.title: Business websites
items.text: Five to eight pages, Nepali and English, booking or enquiry form, Google Business set up.

items.title: Small web apps
items.text: Order books, class attendance, appointment lists. Built to use on a phone at the counter.

items.title: Fixing what exists
items.text: Slow WordPress, hacked contact form, a site the last developer disappeared from.

props.title: Two project slots open from Magh
props.text: Tell me what you need and I will reply the same day with a rough price.

pages.title: Projects
pages.seoTitle: Projects by Anish Karki, freelance web developer
pages.seoDescription: Selected projects: a school fee portal in Bhaktapur, an appointment system for a Baneshwor clinic, and a shop site with Khalti payments.

image.alt: A doctor talking with a patient

props.heading: Appointment list for a Baneshwor clinic
props.body: Replaced a paper register. Reception books visits from a phone, and patients get an SMS the evening before. The no-show rate at the clinic fell from about one in five to one in twelve.

image.alt: A bright café with long tables

props.heading: Menu and table requests for a Jhamsikhel café
props.body: A menu the owner edits herself, a Nepali and English switch, and a form for groups of eight or more. Google Business photos and hours brought in with it.

image.alt: Students at desks in a classroom

props.heading: Fee reminders for a Bhaktapur school
props.body: Parents pay through Khalti or eSewa and the accountant no longer chases a paper ledger. It handles 620 students across nine classes.

pages.title: Contact
pages.seoTitle: Contact Anish Karki, freelance web developer in Kathmandu
pages.seoDescription: Send a message about a website or web app. Anish replies the same day, Sunday to Friday.

props.heading: Say hello
props.text: Tell me about the business, and roughly what you need. If you have a budget in mind, say it. It saves us both time.
props.success: Thank you. I will reply today or tomorrow.
